_schema.description: Per-module dtype overrides keyed by model variant and mesh shape. Modules without an override use the model-wide default dtype (bfloat16). The model variant key is the basename of the model path; mesh shape is the worker grid (rows x cols, e.g. 1x2 / 1x8). Within a model, lookup tries the exact mesh-shape key first, then 'default'. Module keys: shared_mlp, attention, experts, router, lm_head, embedding. Allowed dtype values: bf16, bfp8, fp32. A mesh-shape entry REPLACES 'default' rather than merging into it, so it must list every module it wants overridden. 'embedding' cannot be bfp8: the embedding weight is stored ROW_MAJOR and BFLOAT8_B requires TILE.

gemma-4-12B-it._comment_wh_bf16: Measured on a real WH T3K. single_tile_matmul_ckc raises the m<=32 projections to HiFi3 + fp32 dest-acc for every weight dtype, so these overrides stack on top of that rather than enabling it. The per-module contribution was measured by walking all 8 (shared_mlp, attention, lm_head) combinations at 1x8 against the 0.97 gate: attention bf16 is worth +0.0394 of test_full_model PCC, shared_mlp bf16 +0.0256, and lm_head bf16 +2.4e-5 -- i.e. nothing, reproduced across all four pairs differing only in lm_head (+2.44e-5, +2.53e-5, +2.37e-5, +2.05e-5), even though lm_head is the 262144-vocab projection and the largest single weight read per decode step. 1x8 therefore takes attention ONLY: test_full_model 0.9507 -> 0.9888, test_full_model_decode 0.9647 -> 0.9831, against 0.9896 / 0.9835 for all-three-bf16 -- 0.0008 of PCC for 13.7% of decode, and it returns shared_mlp's and lm_head's DRAM. Decode wall at 1x8, two reps each, reproducible to 0.01 ms: batch-1 40.01 -> 34.53, long-context-4k 41.51 -> 36.03, batch-32 61.64 -> 56.06 ms/token. 1x2 has only 2x12 GB, bracketed on HW at 11.71 GB/chip allocating and 12.30 GB/chip not, so shared_mlp + lm_head fit (11.71) but attention does not (12.30): test_full_model 0.9780 -> 0.9920, decode 0.9742 -> 0.9907. 1x4 stays all-bfp8 and still gains from the accumulator alone: 0.9591 -> 0.9803 / 0.9643 -> 0.9848. 'embedding' can never be bfp8 -- it is stored ROW_MAJOR and BFLOAT8_B requires TILE.
